PaperTempo instrument recordings

Piano, nylon-string guitar, and steel-string guitar recordings by the Meta Creative Audio team.
Meta Open Sound: https://github.com/facebookincubator/Meta-open-sound
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://github.com/facebookincubator/Meta-open-sound/blob/main/LICENSE).
Piano uses velocity layer 3, nylon guitar uses the fingerstyle layer, and steel-string guitar uses velocity layer 2.

Flute and violin recordings by Sam Gossner and Simon Dalzell, cut by Elan Hickler/Soundemote.
VS Chamber Orchestra Community Edition: https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE
License: CC0 1.0 Universal (https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE/blob/master/LICENSE).
Flute uses non-vibrato sustains and violin uses forte bowed vibrato. Flute root notes follow the official SFZ mapping:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE/SFZ/FluteSusNV.sfz

PaperTempo edits: mono 24 kHz PCM, trimmed onsets and tails, gain normalization, and crossfaded sustain loops for flute and violin.

Each bundled file and its original download:
